profile: Mac Companion host Interactive role ingress v0.1
rules: classification requires a complete strict interactive.channel.hello and derives the closed role from its decoded body
the classifier transfers the exact first frame and already verified TLS connection together as one-use authority
one unauthenticated candidate progresses at a time and at most three later accepted connections wait in FIFO order before excess candidates close
parallel client input and media dials may both complete without concurrent unauthenticated framing work or in-flight candidate replacement
the host pump reads no role byte before exact accepted-frame send completion
hello is original and challenge, prove, and accepted each correlate to their immediate predecessor
fresh host nonce and distinct response message identifiers are generated for every attempted handshake
the Agent runtime owner retains and mutates the credential authority without transferring or copying its credential
begin and proof consumption each recheck exact client, primary connection, session, epoch, channel, and role
the listener retains each authenticated role identity and publishes a pair only when client, primary connection, session, and authorization epoch match
a cross-session or cross-epoch role candidate closes both role connections instead of replacing or combining either authority
malformed framing, duplicate IDs, correlation mismatch, authority rejection, timeout, cancellation, and connection failure invalidate the challenged authority and close the connection
ready handoff retains the verified TLS binding and exact channel, role, primary connection, session, and epoch fence
